t: 君士坦提乌斯三世成为西罗马帝国的共治皇帝。
te: Constantius III becomes co-emperor of the Western Roman Empire.
dz: 君士坦提乌斯三世成为西罗马帝国的共治皇帝。
de: Constantius III becomes co-emperor of the Western Roman Empire.

t: 特奥多修斯二世皇帝在君士坦丁堡(拜占庭帝国)与艾莉娅·尤多西亚结婚.
te: Emperor Theodosius II marries Aelia Eudocia at Constantinople (Byzantine Empire).
